{{Quote|I used to have a heaping serving of skillet-cooked hash for breakfast every morning during my days as a brawler on Ord Mantell. Talk about a hearty breakfast! This hash is made with a generous amount of bantha beef, Ojomian onions and protatoes. Even if you're not wrestling Mantellian savrips for a living, you'll want to give it a try.|The menu at Dex's description of the hash|<ref name="DaD" />}}
'''"Besalisk's Bellyful" hash''' was a dish made by the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]]. The dish's ingredients were [[Bantha steak/Legends|beef]] from a [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]], [[Ojomian onion]]s, and [[Protato/Legends|protatoes]], which were cooked together in a [[Skillet/Legends|skillet]]. Jettster ate a large portion of the hash every morning during his [[Time/Legends|time]] working as a [[Gladiator/Legends|brawler]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], where he wrestled [[Mantellian Savrip/Legends|Mantellian Savrips]]. When the Besalisk later opened an [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] named [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] in the [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]] district of the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], he included the dish on the menu as a breakfast meal costing 8.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] with a breakfast side dish included in the price. The hash was served at the eatery<ref name="DaD" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
"Besalisk's Bellyful" hash was featured in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," a [[2009]] [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] exclusive article that was written by [[Gregory Walker]] in the style of an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner.<ref name="DaD" />
